detail.longDescription: I get a lot of traffic to my website from Singapore. Like 15,000 a month. They spend only 2 seconds on the site. Problem: I want to rate limit traffic from Singapore: So if there are like 1000 requests per limit, then that's obviously from a bad source. How can I block this traffic in a way that doesn't block legitimate traffic from Singapore? I am using NGINX, AWS, and Google Analytics.
